messages:
dmitri: quick thread to capture ideas from the call: cross-region demote bounce is still a big risk for proportional fairness. sharing notes here.

anya: tl;dr problem: tenant gets demoted in region A -> traffic shifts to region B -> region B demotes -> traffic flips back -> global churn. we need a single source of truth for demote decisions.

kevin: agreed. two-layer approach i suggested: 1) regional fast path (edge EWMA for immediate shed) 2) global coordinator that issues conservative demote commitments with a cooling window. edges consult both.

olivia: implementation wrinkle: proxies operate offline for short intervals (network partition). how do they respect global commitments when unreachable?

dmitri: idea: central returns signed demote tokens with fields: tenant_id, demote_factor, issued_at, cool_until, signature. proxies cache token and enforce until cool_until even if offline. token TTL must be conservative.

kevin: sample token JSON (signed blob):
```
{ "tid":"acme-42", "factor":0.6, "issued_at":1680000000, "cool_until":1680000600, "nonce":"r123" }
```
proxies validate sig and apply.

anya: need metrics: global_demote_tokens_issued, region_token_staleness, proxy_enforce_failures. Also track redirect_rate when demoted.

olivia: on the policy side: prefer additive backoff for small tenants instead of multiplicative demote, reduces starvation. e.g., reduce qps by -X rather than *factor. less punishing.

kevin: tradeoff: additive helps tiny tenants but won't stop massive bursts. proposal: hybrid: if baseline_share < threshold use additive, else multiplicative. config knobs exposed per-tenant.

dmitri: cross-region dampening: central controller computes global_demote_score per tenant = EWMA(local_demotes) across all regions, decays with half-life 30m. if score > 0.7, block new regional rollouts and force global cooling.

opsbot: ci-run: fairness-sim-042: 10k rps, 150 tenants, 3-region bounce sim -> peak global_demote_score for tenant acme-42 = 0.82, observed 12% p95 degradation for tiny tenants in region C. logs: https://ci.internal/1888

anya: follow-ups: 1) dmitri to draft demote token schema + signature spec. 2) kevin to add hybrid additive/multiplicative policy to proxy lib. 3) olivia to add offline-enforcement tests in chaos suite. 4) ops to run larger sim with sticky clients.

kevin: rollout idea: feature-flag tokens in non-prod for 2 weeks, watch region_token_staleness and redirect_rate. expose kill-switch: central.demote_disable=true.

olivia: notes on tuning: short cool windows (<=2m) risk oscillation; long windows (>=15m) risk long term starvation. default conservative: cool_until = now + 5m and global score decay half-life 30m.

dmitri: we should also add a backpressure hint header for clients `X-Redwood-Demote-Hint: 0.6` so SDKs can self-throttle gracefully instead of instant retrying.

anya: good call. SDKs can implement jittered backoff and avoid move-to-other-region loop. add to SDK backlog.

kevin: i'll open a draft PR with token format + proxy lib changes: `eng/proxy/fairness/tokens_v1.go`.

opsbot: created ticket FW-789: cross-region-demote-tokens.

dmitri: short doc next: i'll sketch token lifecycle, signature algorithm (ed25519), and an example enforcement flow. ping me for reviews.

olivia: thanks all, capturing this as experiment plan. meet tomorrow 10am to review PR + chaos results. :thumbsup:
